description.value: The Travelodge by Wyndham Kamloops Mountview is a chain hotel situated in the Mountview area of Kamloops, a city that sits at the junction of several major cycling corridors in BC's Interior. As part of the Travelodge brand under Wyndham, it offers a recognizable mid-range accommodation option for touring cyclists passing through or staging rides in the Thompson Valley region. Kamloops is a natural overnight stop on routes such as the Trans Canada and the Kettle Valley, making this hotel a practical base.
